description: GitOps add-ons and scripts: gitops/platform-addons/ ArgoCD Applications for metrics-server (chart 3.14.0) and aws-load-balancer-controller (chart 3.6.2) pointing at the official Helm repos, with __CLUSTER_NAME__/__REGION__/__VPC_ID__ placeholders; provision.sh step 6b guarded by INSTALL_ADDONS and DRY_RUN; common.sh render helper; destroy.sh deletes Ingress objects before LoadBalancer Services. Covers plan.md items 5 and 6. Depends on FEAT-001 only for the Pod Identity service account name aws-load-balancer-controller in kube-system and the vpc_id output.
steps: Item 5: read the eks-cluster-argocd app-of-apps shape, re-read both Helm repo index.yaml files and each chart values.yaml, then create gitops\platform-addons\metrics-server.yaml, aws-load-balancer-controller.yaml and README.md. Use only keys that exist in the chart values. Automated sync with prune false and selfHeal true. replicas 1 and small requests (t3.medium holds 17 pods).

Item 6a: edit scripts\common.sh: ADDONS_DIR, INSTALL_ADDONS (0 or 1 validated), VPC_ID_REGEX, render_addon (bash parameter expansion, regex validation, fail if a __PLACEHOLDER__ remains, no eval, no sed).

Item 6b: edit scripts\provision.sh: step 6b after the ArgoCD wait lines, honoring INSTALL_ADDONS and DRY_RUN, reading VPC_ID from 'tf output -raw vpc_id', applying each rendered Application through 'kc apply -f -', waiting for Healthy; failures go through the existing on_error trap; update header comment and closing banner.

Item 6c: edit scripts\destroy.sh preflight_cleanup: list and delete Ingresses first, wait up to 5 minutes, warn (do not fail) if some remain, then the existing LoadBalancer Service block; add the elbv2 leftovers command to the printed text. Keep typed confirmation, reg_safe and DRY_RUN handling.
acceptance_criteria: Both Application manifests exist, pin chart versions 3.14.0 and 3.6.2 from the official repos, contain no value for a Secret, and the LBC manifest uses only the three placeholders __CLUSTER_NAME__, __REGION__, __VPC_ID__
render_addon uses ${text//__X__/$value} with validated values, no eval, no sed, every expansion quoted, and dies if a placeholder is left
provision.sh skips step 6b when INSTALL_ADDONS=0, prints instead of running under DRY_RUN=1, and keeps all existing checks (account guard, typed confirmation, registry flow, ArgoCD install)
destroy.sh deletes Ingress objects before Service type LoadBalancer, keeps the typed confirmation and the destroy_failed bookkeeping
bash -n passes for common.sh, provision.sh and destroy.sh
verification: python -c "import yaml,sys; [list(yaml.safe_load_all(open(f, encoding='utf-8'))) for f in sys.argv[1:]]" c:/Devops/Repository/Developer-friendly-infra/gitops/platform-addons/metrics-server.yaml c:/Devops/Repository/Developer-friendly-infra/gitops/platform-addons/aws-load-balancer-controller.yaml

cd c:/Devops/Repository/Developer-friendly-infra && echo dev-eu | DRY_RUN=1 REGISTRY_PATH=/tmp/r.json PUBLIC_ACCESS_CIDRS=203.0.113.7/32 TF_STATE_BUCKET=dummy bash scripts/provision.sh dev-eu staging   (needs terraform, aws, kubectl on PATH; prints only)
cd c:/Devops/Repository/Developer-friendly-infra && echo dev-eu | DRY_RUN=1 REGISTRY_PATH=/tmp/r.json TF_STATE_BUCKET=dummy bash scripts/destroy.sh dev-eu
If the shell is down: mark UNVERIFIED and re-read the three scripts for quoting and set -Eeuo pipefail behavior
findings: Created in Developer-friendly-infra: gitops/platform-addons/{metrics-server.yaml,aws-load-balancer-controller.yaml,README.md}. Edited scripts/common.sh (ADDONS_DIR, INSTALL_ADDONS, validate_install_addons, REGION_REGEX, VPC_ID_REGEX, PLACEHOLDER_REGEX, render_addon), scripts/provision.sh (header, validate_install_addons call, step 6b, closing banner), scripts/destroy.sh (header, Ingress delete+wait block before the LoadBalancer Service block, third elbv2 leftovers command, dry-run text). Placeholders: __CLUSTER_NAME__, __REGION__, __VPC_ID__ (quoted in the manifest so names like yes or null stay strings), only in the LBC manifest. Flags: INSTALL_ADDONS=0|1 (default 1; anything else dies in provision.sh step 1), DRY_RUN=1 renders both manifests with a made-up VPC id vpc-00000000 to check them and does not read terraform output. Charts: metrics-server 3.14.0 and aws-load-balancer-controller 3.6.2 from the official repos (index.yaml re-read); both automated sync with prune false and selfHeal true; LBC has ServerSideApply=true because it ships CRDs; replicas 1; requests 50m/64Mi (metrics-server) and 50m/128Mi (LBC). LBC serviceAccount.name is aws-load-balancer-controller to match the FEAT-001 Pod Identity association; region and vpcId are set explicitly. Deviation from plan: health wait uses a retry loop over kubectl get -o jsonpath (40 x 15s) rather than kubectl wait --for=jsonpath; also added a kubectl wait for CRD applications.argoproj.io Established before apply. destroy.sh also sleeps 30s after Ingress removal for ENI release, and uses its own ing_waited counter. UNVERIFIED (shell returned Exit Code -1): bash -n on the three scripts, YAML parse of both manifests, provision.sh and destroy.sh dry runs; exact commands are in verification.md under ## FEAT-002. Values read from master chart values.yaml, not the tagged packages. LBC chart enables a Service mutator webhook with failurePolicy Fail by default (documented in the add-ons README). RUNBOOK.md and VERSIONS.md should mention INSTALL_ADDONS, the two chart versions and the LBC policy re-download.
